name: gifsicle
notes: 2026-11-01: GIF optimisation and editing; post-processes gifski or agg output.
2026-11-01: Triage: assess. Report rates it worth cataloguing.
2026-11-24: Toolkit guide written from examples/gifsicle-optimise evidence (gifsicle 1.98).

evidence.result: 6-frame 64x64 ffmpeg GIF (12/24/4/16/28/4 cs, loop 2, 12479 B). -O3: 10869 B, frames and delays identical, 6/6 RGBA frames identical. --lossy=80: 10811 B. --colors=16: 4929 B, table 16, 15 colours. Repeat -O3 byte-identical.
evidence.scope: gifsicle -O3 keeps 6 frames, delays, loop and decoded RGBA identical and smaller; --colors=16 table<=16, smaller; --lossy=80 smaller, timing kept; ffmpeg GIF input; macOS arm64

summary: Command-line GIF optimizer and editor for reducing file size, inspecting, combining and modifying animated GIFs. It is a focused post-processing step after GIF generation.
use_when: Optimize or edit an existing animated GIF
Post-process GIF output from agg or another encoder
avoid_when: Use gifski for high-quality GIF encoding from video or frames
Use FFmpeg for broader animated-image and video workflows

assessment.rationale: The upstream repository identifies 1.99; its NEWS lists 1.98 dated 2026-10-15, but the date for 1.99 was not established. It remains a focused GIF optimization/editor beside encoder tools.
